name: Cathedral Altar And Incense Fixture
knownLimits: This is the first asset-level altar/incense candidate with generated painted stained-glass panels, not final cathedral altar art.
Retable glass now uses the same painted lancet texture candidate as wall windows, but panel repetition is still visible.
Smoke now uses subtle low-poly translucent puff columns instead of hard cone geometry, but it is still authored geometry rather than a true shader/particle effect.
